items.title: GitHub Student Developer Pack
items.description: The ultimate student developer arsenal. Includes free GitHub Copilot, 100+ developer tools, free domain names, DigitalOcean credits, and premium tiers.
items.verificationMethod: Amity ID Card upload or @amity.edu email
howToClaim: Go to education.github.com/pack with your GitHub account logged in.
Upload a clear photo of your Amity Student ID card or connect your Amity email.
Approval takes 2-24 hours. Enjoy lifetime access while enrolled.

items.title: JetBrains All Products Pack
items.description: Get free licenses for WebStorm, IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate, PyCharm Professional, CLion, GoLand, and Rider for your university coursework and projects.
items.verificationMethod: Official college email or ISIC card
howToClaim: Visit the JetBrains Student Program portal.
Enter your university email address or submit Amity enrollment proof.
Renew annually with one click until graduation.

items.title: Spotify Premium Student Plan
items.description: Ad-free music, unlimited song skips, offline downloads, and high-fidelity audio at half price for registered university students in India.
items.verificationMethod: Instant SheerID verification via Student Portal / ID upload
howToClaim: Open Spotify Student portal and log in to your account.
Select Amity University Kolkata from the SheerID drop-down.
Verify using student portal credentials or upload your student ID.

items.title: Apple Education Store & Back-to-School
items.description: Special pricing on MacBook Air, MacBook Pro, and iPad Air/Pro. Annual back-to-school offer includes free AirPods or Apple Pencil, plus 20% off AppleCare+.
howToClaim: Sign up on UNiDAYS India with your Amity student details.
Once verified, access the Apple India Education Store.
Discounts are applied directly at checkout with official Apple warranty.

items.title: Notion Plus with Unlimited Blocks
items.description: Full Notion Plus plan free for students and educators. Unlimited page blocks, 5MB+ file uploads, 30-day version history, and collaborative workspace.
items.verificationMethod: College email verification in account settings
howToClaim: Create or switch your Notion account email to your student email.
Go to Settings & Members > Upgrade > Get free education plan.
Activated instantly.

items.title: Figma & FigJam Professional Education
items.description: Unlock unlimited Figma design files, team libraries, shared design systems, audio chat, and FigJam boards for your UI/UX and product designs.
howToClaim: Visit figma.com/education and click Apply as Student.
Select Amity University and your expected graduation year.
Instant access granted for 2 years.

items.title: Canva Pro for Students
items.description: Premium presentation templates, 100M+ stock assets, magic background remover, and brand kit generators for college fest posters and club decks.
items.verificationMethod: GitHub Pack integration or student email
howToClaim: Claim through GitHub Student Developer Pack with 1 click.
Enjoy 1 year of free Canva Pro access directly.

items.title: AWS Educate & Cloud Credits
items.description: Build backend APIs, train machine learning models on EC2, host static web apps on S3/CloudFront without requiring a credit card.
howToClaim: Register on AWS Educate using your college details.
Claim your student starter credits and launch instances in the sandbox.

items.title: Microsoft Azure for Students
items.description: Free $100 credit for 12 months with no credit card required. Free access to Linux VMs, App Services, Cosmos DB, and OpenAI cognitive services.
howToClaim: Sign in to Azure portal with your student account.
Verify via OTP sent to university email.
Credits activated immediately.

items.title: YouTube Premium Student Membership
items.description: Ad-free YouTube videos, background play while using other apps, offline downloads, and YouTube Music streaming app included.
howToClaim: Open YouTube Premium Student page.
Enter Amity University details on the SheerID screen.
Complete payment using UPI or student debit card.

items.title: Autodesk Education Suite
items.description: AutoCAD, Fusion 360, Revit, Maya, and 3ds Max available free of cost for architecture, biotechnology, and engineering students.
items.verificationMethod: Official ID card or admission transcript upload
howToClaim: Create an Autodesk Education account.
Upload a picture of your current semester Amity ID card or fee receipt.
Verification takes less than 30 minutes.

items.title: Samsung Student Advantage India
items.description: Exclusive student pricing on Galaxy S/Z series, Galaxy Book laptops, and Galaxy Tab S9. Free accidental and liquid damage protection for 1 year.
howToClaim: Enter your student email ID to receive a verification OTP.
Browse the Samsung Corporate & Student store with instant discounts.
